frames.title: Black Marble paired light change
frames.limitation: Only pixels passing quality checks on BOTH 3 Jan and 8 Feb 2023, with baseline radiance ≥10 nW/(cm² sr), are compared. Purple excludes unavailable, poor-quality or low-baseline pairs. Orange: ≥40% lower radiance; blue: other eligible pairs. This is not building damage or proof of an outage.

limitsMeaning: Product-specific observation limits. Clear pixels do not establish that the ground is safe. Snow-layer transparency alone cannot distinguish snow-free ground, clouds, water and missing data.

highResolution.limitations: Historical before/after comparison. Different view angles, shadows, seasonal change and registration differences can resemble damage. No automated damage classifier is bundled. Native source GSD differs from the ~1 m exported map grid.
